title: A pre-norm transformer block with SwiGLU and RoPE
brief: Wire attention and a gated feed-forward network into one residual block, and give it a working sense of position two ways.
hints: sinusoidal_encoding fills even columns with sin(p * theta**(-2i/d)) and odd columns with cos of the same angle, for i = 0..d/2-1 and theta = 10000.

rope_frequencies returns theta ** (-2*i/d) for i = 0..d/2-1; build cos/sin tables by taking the outer product of positions with these frequencies and concatenating the result with itself along the last axis.
apply_rope splits the last axis in half, forms rotate_half(x) = concatenate([-x2, x1]), and returns x * cos + rotate_half(x) * sin.
swiglu is (silu(x @ W_gate) * (x @ W_up)) @ W_down, with silu(z) = z * sigmoid(z).
In transformer_block_forward, apply RoPE to queries and keys per head before the scaled dot product; zeroing Wo or W_down should make that sublayer contribute nothing to the residual stream.
